title: Forensic IMAP Downloader
description: Forensic IMAP Downloader is a program that allows downloading emails from IMAP servers in forensic mode.
details: It allows you to set filters and download only emails of interest, supports simultaneous downloads and offers the ability to pause and resume download. At the end it inserts the downloaded files in a .zip archive and calculates its SHA-1 HASH. All steps are also detailed within a final report.
